relation: The same proposition is tested across named target groups or institutions.
potential_increment: Generality versus target selectivity; location of a social or institutional boundary.
strong_source_signals: Common stem/grid; identical response topology; only target changes.
common_false_positive: Items share a topic but ask different propositions.

relation: The same judgment is tested under explicitly varying conditions or exceptions.
strong_source_signals: Condition battery; repeated stem; condition labels.
common_false_positive: Different outcomes or different normative questions disguised as conditions.

relation: A general norm or principle is paired with a concrete target, case or institutional application.
potential_increment: Principle/application divergence; practical boundary of an abstract commitment.
strong_source_signals: Explicit principle item plus application item; source or semantic linkage.
common_false_positive: Two items merely share a driver label.

relation: A public or moral commitment is paired with a tax, sacrifice, risk, redistribution or autonomy cost.
potential_increment: Cost-sensitive commitment; declared norm versus willingness to bear consequences.
strong_source_signals: Same policy/goal with explicit cost item.
common_false_positive: Economic insecurity conditioning a separate attitude.
likely_owner: V550J or V552J after ownership gate

relation: Support for an end is paired with approval or rejection of mechanisms used to achieve it.
common_false_positive: Different policy domains with weak thematic similarity.

relation: A general category judgment is paired with judgments about governed subtypes.
strong_source_signals: Taxonomic target relation is source- or authority-governed.
common_false_positive: Assumed hierarchy not present in source semantics.

relation: Parallel confidence/legitimacy judgments across institution types.
potential_increment: Generalized versus concentrated trust/distrust; coercive/political/service differentiation.
strong_source_signals: Parallel trust battery; stable scale; institution targets.
common_false_positive: Averaging institutions into an unsupported latent trust trait.
likely_owner: V550J when pattern semantics are explicit; otherwise individual atoms

relation: A normative position is paired with expected or self-reported conduct under a related circumstance.
strong_source_signals: Same target and clearly linked action domain.
common_false_positive: Causal or predictive inference beyond the question wording.

relation: A later item is asked because of an earlier response or module path.
potential_increment: Contingent meaning that is unintelligible without routing context.
strong_source_signals: Explicit skip/routing instructions and compatible respondent universe.
common_false_positive: Treating inapplicable items as missing or neutral.

relation: A structural-position or pressure variable may bend another attitude without forming one semantic proposition.
strong_source_signals: Different semantic objects; plausible conditioning relation.
common_false_positive: Forcing all interactions into J-family authority.

relation: Meaning emerges from the same or harmonized orientation across historical periods.
potential_increment: Trajectory, persistence, reversal or pressure-sensitive change.
strong_source_signals: Cross-wave semantic equivalence and temporal identity.
common_false_positive: Treating cross-wave comparison as one respondent-level family.

relation: Responses co-vary statistically without a source-governed compositional proposition.
